profile.headline: Lead Web Developer
profile.summary:
I am passionate about creating robust, scalable, and high-performance software solutions. With extensive expertise in technologies such as React.js, React Native, Node.js, C#, Javascript, AWS, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, I bring over 10 years of experience in driving the development of innovative software products. My focus is on leading development efforts and collaborating with teams to consistently deliver exceptional results.

With a strong foundation in both front-end and back-end technologies, I excel in developing full-stack web and mobile applications that are both user-friendly and maintainable. I am passionate about leveraging my technical skills to solve complex challenges, optimize performance, and drive innovation.

Whether it's architecting a new system from the ground up, optimizing existing applications, or mentoring and leading a team of developers, I am committed to delivering quality results that align with business goals and user needs.

projects.title: Email App
projects.description:
•    Created web application and windows application similar to Gmail that has Inbox, sent folder, view email, forward email, delete email, compose email and trash folder functionalities

- Technologies used: JAVA, JSF, MySQL, JDBC, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, Glassfish Server
